evidence_rows.claim: The prior wording created promotion leakage because a study-supported design pattern was phrased as if it were already controller truth/implemented policy rather than an evidence-bounded proposal.
evidence_rows.scope: evidence-governance audit of prior reasoning output

evidence_rows.claim: Retain action-origin and execution-authority as separate audit fields, but represent the no-history-promotion rule as a candidate invariant requiring local falsification and matched controller evaluation before promotion.

Whether no-history-promotion should be unconditional across all tool, memory, delegation, and recovery regimes remains unestablished in this role state and must not be treated as globally validated controller truth.

optimistic_drift_findings.detail: The evidence supported a defense pattern in reported benchmark settings, while the prior synthesis compressed that into categorical implementation-style language. This is stronger than the evidence status warrants.

promotion_leakage_findings.detail: SUPPORTED external evidence and a PROPOSED controller rule were not explicitly separated in the prior outward report. The rule must be downgraded to PROPOSED until local matched evidence exists.

revision.rule: No-history-promotion remains a candidate guardrail, not promoted controller truth. Future checkpoints must tag external observations, supported claims, inferences, proposals, and deferred generalizations separately.
